name: Guillermo and Will
overview: Guillermo & Will are two little boy worms, and they are the best-est of buddies... and guess what?! Guillermo speaks mostly Spanish and Will speaks mostly English! With a light language curriculum and a “love thy neighbor” message, this wiggly-fun adventure series will worm its way into your hearts! Brothers from other mothers, Guillermo & Will love playing, silliness, and exploring the wonders of God’s world... juntos/together!
